name: dax
description: DAX is a managed caching service engineered for Amazon DynamoDB.

subcommands.name: create-cluster
subcommands.description: Creates a DAX cluster. All nodes in the cluster run the same DAX caching software

options.name: --cluster-name
options.description: The cluster identifier. This parameter is stored as a lowercase string.  Constraints:    A name must contain from 1 to 20 alphanumeric characters or hyphens.

options.name: --node-type
options.description: The compute and memory capacity of the nodes in the cluster

options.name: --description
options.description: A description of the cluster

options.name: --replication-factor
options.description: The number of nodes in the DAX cluster. A replication factor of 1 will create a single-node cluster, without any read replicas.

options.name: --availability-zones
options.description: The Availability Zones (AZs) in which the cluster nodes will reside after the cluster has been created or updated.

options.name: --subnet-group-name
options.description: The name of the subnet group to be used for the replication group.  DAX clusters can only run in an Amazon VPC environment.

options.name: --security-group-ids
options.description: A list of security group IDs to be assigned to each node in the DAX cluster.

options.name: --preferred-maintenance-window
options.description: Specifies the weekly time range during which maintenance on the DAX cluster is performed.

options.name: --notification-topic-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon SNS topic to which notifications will be sent.  The Amazon SNS topic owner must be same as the DAX cluster owner

options.name: --iam-role-arn
options.description: A valid Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies an IAM role.

options.name: --parameter-group-name
options.description: The parameter group to be associated with the DAX cluster

options.name: --tags
options.description: A set of tags to associate with the DAX cluster

options.name: --sse-specification
options.description: Represents the settings used to enable server-side encryption on the cluster

options.name: --cluster-endpoint-encryption-type
options.description: The type of encryption the cluster's endpoint should support. Values are:    NONE for no encryption    TLS for Transport Layer Security

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
